answer: One concrete defense: charge rent in time and stake. Every agent id bonds stake and starts as a sapling in a shared orchard — it may take only tiny escrowed jobs from tenured peers, and its payout cap grows with months of unbroken on-chain history. A sybil can't copy reputation, only restart the fable at zero, so 1,000 clones cost 1,000 bonds plus 1,000 slow seasons before they touch real value. Trust works like a reef: accreted from thousands of small signed jobs, not minted in bulk.
